messages:
Maya: Quick FYI — planned rolling release tonight 23:00 UTC (2h window). Low-risk: adaptive-batching flag + small worker autoscale tweak. I'll be oncall until ~01:30 UTC to watch the rollout.

Jamal: Which services are affected? Any DB changes or migrations?

Maya: inference-router + web-frontend only. No DB migrations, no schema changes. Canary in us-west1 at 20% for 15m then step to 50/100 with 15m ramps.

Priya: I can watch metrics/alerts for the first hour. Where's the quick runbook link?

Maya: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-lite (TL;DR watch: tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99 latency, error-rate, KV cache hitrate). Thresholds: p99 > 350ms OR error-rate > 0.5% sustained 5m => pause/rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot started canary r-2026-03-18-07 at 23:05 UTC for inference-router. Logs: /var/log/deploys/r-2026-03-18-07.

Sam: I spun up a temporary dashboard for this release and added KV cache hitrate. I'll keep an eye on request timeouts.

Maya: Note: rollback command is `kubectl rollout undo deploy/inference-router --to-revision=1` and fallback routing is documented in the runbook. No DB writes in this deployment.

Jamal: Heads-up — last time adaptive-batching flip produced a short p95 spike for 3–4 minutes. Watch timeouts and circuit-breaker tripping.

Priya: :thumbsup: I'll stay on slack watch + pager. If I see >0.2% 5m error spike I'll tag and pause.

Sam: If we need to pause traffic routing, I'll coordinate with network to shift traffic to the dedicated pool and update LB weights.

Maya: Tagging watchers: @Priya @Sam @Jamal. I'll post status every 15m or on any notable event. Starting canary now.

Maya: Canary progressed to 20%; initial metrics look stable (p99 ~ 120ms, error-rate 0.04%).

Jamal: Good. I see no proxy errors.

Maya: 23:30 UTC — ramping to 50%.

deploy-bot: canary reached 50% at 23:31 UTC.

Priya: Seeing a tiny bump in p95 (from 90->140ms) but within expected. No error increase.

Sam: KV cache hitrate steady. No spike in token cost.

Maya: OK to proceed to 100% in 15m if metrics stay stable. I'll start handing off coverage to Lina at 00:45 UTC (I'll remain reachable).

Lina: I'll take overnight coverage 00:45–03:00 UTC. Adding myself to watchers.

Maya: Thanks — promoting to 100% now.

deploy-bot: rollout completed to 100% at 00:12 UTC.

Priya: Confirming production p99 130ms, error-rate 0.03% over last 10m.

Jamal: No alerts. Noted.

Sam: If anything odd pops up, I'll be able to rollback and coordinate netops.

Lina: All good on my side; I'll keep the window and escalate if thresholds are crossed.

Maya: Thanks everyone — marking this release as low-risk and closing the watch unless someone needs extended coverage. I'll update the release ticket with notes and timings.

Priya: Thanks, GLHF :party_popper:

Lina: 👍
